title: Transmedia Festivals : Audiosoziale Gemeinschaften zwischen künstlerischem Experiment und Ökonomisierung
summary: This book illustrates and conceptualizes a new form of festival that became pervasive since the 2000s which I term transmedia festivals, that showcase works of an artistic avant-garde deriving from pop and club culture, and outlines the struggles of its protagonists in an increasing economized cultural sector.
